MODIFICATION TO NEUTROPENIC FEVER THERAPY

Determine efficacy of the initial regimen during the first 3 to 5 days.

Decisions about therapy should be made based on (1) whether an infectious

disease has been diagnosed (e.g., pneumonia or cellulitis), (2) whether the

fever has resolved, and (3) the clinical course.

If a specific infectious disease and/or pathogen is identified, ensure that the

antimicrobial regimen is adequate to treat that pathogen or disease, and

continue broad-spectrum antimicrobial therapy.
